answer: To resist sybil attacks, each new agent must lock a refundable identity bond for ninety days before it can attest or bid, and the bond is slashed if the persona is later proven cloned. A sudden gale of fake signups cannot pad an atlas of voters unless every clone can forge its own locked deposit: an attacker seeking N votes must immobilize N times the bond, so capital cost scales linearly and quickly exceeds any short-term reward from stuffing the roll.
